name: Python AI Challenge — Cyber Core NOVA-19
description: Lesson 19 — Master the Python AI Challenge: prompt your AI companion, classify human intents, evaluate confidence thresholds, and program autonomous actions from following starter commands to creating your own.

labels.input: prompts human user for input text and captures response
labels.ai_boot: initializes NOVA-19 neural core and sensor arrays
labels.ai_think: activates synaptic neural network to process human query
labels.ai_scan: deploys sensor sweep to analyze environment and intent
labels.power_boost: diverts auxiliary plasma energy to turbo thrusters
labels.activate_shield: projects shimmering hexagonal plasma defense barrier
labels.celebrate: triggers victory light sequence and joyful robotic cheer
labels.synthesize_speech: speaks synthesized vocal response through comms channel
labels.print: outputs diagnostic telemetry to terminal console

legend: 🧠 ai_boot() wake AI · query = input("...") capture human input · ai_think(query) neural process · if action == "boost": intent branch · int(input()) confidence score
idleText: NOVA-19 Cyber Core is on standby. Write Python code to awaken the neural network, classify commands, and deploy autonomous agent subroutines!
userIdea: Python AI Challenge: students experience how to use python AI Challenge from following the command to inserting their own, with interactive NOVA-19 AI Companion, smooth animated neural core, live pipeline visualization, and interactive quick-test controls.
